You have $900 in your savings account, which is designated as your emergency fund. Given that you have a high-interest credit card debt, it might be wise to focus on paying down that debt first to reduce the amount of interest you'll pay. However, you should also aim to build up your emergency fund to at least cover three to six months of essential expenses.

Since your emergency fund is currently $900, you might want to aim for a minimum of $3000 to $6000 as a starting goal. If you can manage to pay down some of your credit card debt while setting aside a portion of your monthly income towards your emergency fund, that would be a balanced approach.

This is general information, not financial advice.
